lede: Wednesday's San Miguel County BOCC meeting is the one to watch this week — three Land Use Code amendments go to formal public hearing, including changes to how 'Qualified Owner' is defined in deed-restriction rules, a wildfire-area code update, and a continued hearing on nonconforming lots, all heading toward votes. Alongside that, the Housing Authority Subcommittee takes up a real-world deed-restriction question when a Gold Run homeowner asks to exceed the 5% capital improvement cap for a $47,000 roof replacement. Ouray County's planning commission is quietly working through definition changes to its own land use code — the kind of thing that shapes what the rules mean for years.
